unit.label: -ship
unit.core_meaning: a state, a rank, or a skill
unit.mentor_note: Ship covers three related ideas: what you are (citizenship), where you stand (professorship), and what you can do (penmanship). Which one is meant is always decided by the word in front of it.

members.meaning: the art of writing by hand
the skill of making things well
the careful management of something in one’s care

predict_options.text: A state, a rank, or a skill
A group of people working together

discovery.understand_note: Ship has nothing to do with boats: it is an old word for shape or condition. Craftsmanship is the condition of being a craftsman: that is, the skill itself.

applies.prompt: Knowing -ship names a state or skill, and a steward manages what belongs to another, what is stewardship?

options.text: The careful management of something entrusted to you
